    assert sha(pathlib.Path(entry['output']))==entry['sha256']
expected={'MatrixGrassmannSpecialization': '5363246b96ef23fb76e74e5a557ae5f78c098cf1aa3c955a842c91d1abe0c17b', 'MatrixGrassmannSpecializationChecks': '5ccb3185427314141af59dc21cd0b6f1f1bf02e95813a79a0bd24483930a4135'}

    out=work/'lib/lean/PvNP/RealizableHardness'/f'{name}.olean'
    log=diag/f'{name}-{time.time_ns()}.log';meta=log.with_suffix('.json')
    cmd=[str(lean),'-R','lean','-o',str(out),str(source)]
    before=sha(source)
    assert name in expected and before==expected[name]
    assert not out.exists()
    with log.open('wb') as f:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)

    print(log.read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),flush=True)
    print('ACTUAL_EXIT',rc,'METADATA',str(meta),flush=True)
    if rc:sys.exit(rc)
